Module jelena.etfbl.bustraintransport
Package jelena.etfbl.scenes

Class SceneManager

java.lang.Object
jelena.etfbl.scenes.SceneManager
public class SceneManager extends Object
SceneManager is a utility class for switching between JavaFX scenes.

It supports caching of already-loaded FXML files and their controllers so that returning to a previously opened scene preserves its state. When switching to main-view.fxml, the entire cache is cleared to ensure a fresh start.

      public static void switchScene(javafx.scene.Node anyNode, String fxmlPath)

      Equivalent to calling switchScene(Node, String, Consumer) with null as the consumer.

      fxmlPath - the path to the FXML file

    • switchScene

      public static <C> C switchScene(javafx.scene.Node anyNode, String fxmlPath, Consumer<C> afterLoad)
      Switches the scene of the given node's window to the FXML file specified by fxmlPath.

      Scenes are cached so that returning to a scene restores its state. If the FXML path ends with main-view.fxml, the entire cache is cleared.

      Type Parameters:
      C - the type of the controller
      Parameters:
      anyNode - any node from the current scene
      fxmlPath - the path to the FXML file
      afterLoad - an optional consumer called with the controller after the scene is loaded or reused
      Returns:
      the controller associated with the FXML file
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if the FXML file cannot be loaded
